clips.title: The story
paras: A Faded Journal Page is an old parchment retrieved from an upstairs chest in Marshal Haggard's secluded home in Elwynn Forest. It serves as a vital clue in unraveling the dark history surrounding Stalvan Mistmantle.

Left behind inside an old trunk when retired Marshal Haggard took residence near the eastern border of Elwynn Forest, this weathered parchment sat undisturbed for years. With Haggard's failing eyesight preventing him from deciphering it, the page remained neglected until adventurers digging into the legend of Stalvan Mistmantle retrieved it.
